battleTraits.name: TWIN TIDES
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn(Army), Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability for a friendly AKHELIAN unit
battleTraits.effect:
Used By: The friendly AKHELIAN unit using that ATTACK ability.
Pick a visible friendly NAMARTI unit that has not used an ATTACK ability this phase to be the target.
• If this unit used a SHOOT ability, immediately after the Shoot ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a SHOOT ability as if it were your shooting phase.
• If this unit used a FIGHT ability, immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability. If the target does so, for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons but all of its attacks must target enemy units that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s attacks.

battleTraits.name: CONCEALING TIDE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other TIDAL abilities this battle round.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units that did not use any CHARGE abilities in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: SWIFT TIDE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Concealing Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other TIDAL abilities this battle round.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle round, friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units can use RUN abilities and still use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities later in the turn.

battleTraits.name: SEA’S EMBRACE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Swift Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other TIDAL abilities this battle round.
battleTraits.effect: Friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units have STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: UNPREDICTABLE TIDE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other TIDAL abilities this battle round. Pick a friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN unit that is not in combat to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: INEXORABLE TIDE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other TIDAL abilities this battle round.
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: STORM'S WRATH
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Inexorable Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other TIDAL abilities this battle round.
battleTraits.effect: Friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units’ melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: TEACHINGS OF THE ASYDRAZOR
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

battleTraits.name: THE SHIELD OF ULCHISS
battleTraits.declare: You must spend 1 asydrazor point each time a friendly FIRST PHALANX unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• That unit can use a RETREAT ability and still use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities later in the turn.
• No mortal damage is inflicted on that unit by RETREAT abilities.

battleTraits.name: THE SPEAR OF ASPHOREN
battleTraits.declare: You must spend 1 asydrazor point each time a friendly FIRST PHALANX unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for that unit for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: THE SWORD OF GWYNNAR
battleTraits.declare: You must spend 1 asydrazor point each time a friendly FIRST PHALANX unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: That unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: THE OCEAN CONCEALS
battleTraits.declare: THis ability must be used to deploy the friendly CHORRILEUM EIDOLON instead of the ‘Deploy Unit’ ability or the ‘Deploy Regiment’ ability.
battleTraits.effect: Set up the friendly CHORRILEUM EIDOLON in reserve awaiting a summons. It has now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: SPIRITS OF THE CHORRILEUM
battleTraits.effect:
Each turn, you can gain up to 1 chorrileum spirit point. You gain 1 chorrileum spirit point the first time 1 of the following occurs in a turn:
• You make an unmodified casting roll of 8 or more for a friendly ISHARANN WIZARD.
• An enemy unit is destroyed while it is within 12" of any friendly ISHARANN units.
• A friendly unit is destroyed while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly ISHARANN units or while it is contesting an objective you control

battleTraits.name: CALL FORTH THE TSUNAMI
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have 3 or more chorrileum spirit points. Pick a friendly unit awaiting a summons to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up the target anywhere on the battlefield. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with it.

battleTraits.name: WRATH OF THE MATHLANN
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly CHORRILEUM EIDOLON unit that has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: That unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, that unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn. The unit using this ability cannot use any other RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SURGE FORWARD
abilities.effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly NAMARTI units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly AKHELIAN unit.

abilities.name: WISDOM OF THE DEEP
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, Isharann ritual rolls and lurelight rolls for friendly ISHARANN units while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly ISHARANN units.

abilities.name: FEROCIOUS PREDATORS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with Companion weapons by friendly AKHELIAN units.

abilities.name: FADE LIKE MIST
abilities.effect: When using the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability, you can pick up to 2 eligible targets instead of 1.

abilities.name: OUTFLANK THE ENEMY
abilities.effect:
While a friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN unit is wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge:
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit if it has not charged this turn.
• Add 2" to the Move characteristic of that unit.

abilities.name: BLOOD IN THE WATER
abilities.declare: If any friendly or enemy units were destroyed this turn, pick a friendly Akhelian Allopex unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: STEED OF TIDES
entries.declare: Pick a friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: COUNTER-CURRENT
entries.declare: Pick a friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, halve run rolls and charge rolls for the target.

entries.name: PRESSURE OF THE DEEP
entries.declare: Pick a friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

entries.name: SUMMON INCARNATE OF THE DEEP
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Incarnate of the Deep on the battlefield, pick a friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up an Incarnate of the Deep wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Abyssal Tendril

abilityDetails.name: Watery Clutch
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this MANIFESTATION to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, the target is ensnared for the rest of the turn.
A unit cannot use commands while it is ensnared.

abilityDetails.name: Crushing Coil
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN MANIFESTATIONS that target an ensnared enemy unit.

entries.flavour: When an Incarnate of the Deep senses a distant enemy, it conjures a serpentine tendril of frothing, icy water to hold them fast. Those caught in the choking embrace of this manifestation can do nothing but struggle helplessly as the life is slowly crushed from their body.

entries.name: Akhelian Allopex

abilityDetails.name: Bloodthirsty Predators
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Allopex’s Ferocious Bite while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Ensnared
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER or CAVALRY unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

entries.flavour: Allopexes are vicious predators of the deep, known for their voracious appetites. As Akhelian bond-beasts, they are more dangerous still, boasting scythed fins and deadly back-mounted harpoon launchers. Even the bravest fear these finned menaces.
entries.description:
This unit is armed with Barbed Hooks and Blades, Allopex’s Ferocious Bite and 1 of the following options:
• Razorshell Harpoon
• Retarius Net Launcher

entries.name: Akhelian Ishlaen Guard

abilityDetails.name: Galv-shields
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has WARD (5+) if it charged in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Biovoltaic Barrier
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target unit’s weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Ishlaen Guard channel the bioelectricity of Fangmora mounts into their galv-shields, manifesting this energy as a sparking field that turns aside enemy blows. Thanks to this protective aura, the Ishlaen are often assigned as the bodyguards of Akhelian Kings or other high-ranking Idoneth, seeking the closest threats and laying them low with sweeps of their helsabres.

entries.name: Akhelian King

abilityDetails.name: Wave Rider
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s Akhelian Royal Weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Crest of the Wave
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units for attacks that target enemy units in combat with this unit.

melee: Deepmare’s Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

entries.flavour: Akhelian Kings are the war leaders of the Idoneth enclaves. Mounted atop fierce and intelligent Deepmares, these inspiring commanders fight at the forefront of every battle, urging their Phalanxes forward as they wield their blades with deadly skill.

entries.name: Akhelian Leviadon

abilityDetails.name: Void Drum
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units have WARD (5+) while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Crushing Charge
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy INFANTRY unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target unit has more than 10 models. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Leviadon’s Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws is 5.

melee: Leviadon’s Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws
Crit (Mortal), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: A monstrous undersea titan, the Leviadon is covered in thick scales and protected by an impenetrable shell. In addition to its powerful jaws and bladed fins, it carries a hard-bitten crew and twin harpoon launchers, making it a veritable living fortress.

entries.name: Akhelian Morrsarr Guard

abilityDetails.name: Biovoltaic Blast
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit. Add 1 to each roll if there are more models in the target unit than this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

entries.flavour: Armed with voltspears and galv-shields, the Morrsarr Guard function as heavy shock cavalry, their fearsome weapons channelling the powerful electrical energy given off by the Fangmoras. This shockwave is loosed moments before the Morrsarr crash into the enemy, blasting the front ranks even as the Akhelians’ spears strike home.

entries.name: Akhelian Thrallmaster

abilityDetails.name: Akhelian Insights
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Melee weapons used by friendly NAMARTI units have Crit (2 Hits) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Thrallmaster
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly Namarti Thralls unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

entries.flavour: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle. Master duellists skilled with all manner of exotic weaponry, they scythe through their foes with contemptuous ease.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Akhelian Raidmaster.

entries.name: Cyreni’s Razors

abilityDetails.name: Cyreni of the Abyss
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit’s Cyreni of the Abyss is on the battlefield, it has WIZARD (1).

abilityDetails.name: Phase Ink
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit’s Cephanyr is on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: A true master of the abyss, Cyreni leads her guards through the most inhospitable of places in search of precious soulstuff. She wields the power of a Tidecaster with crushing pressure and an icy chill, having trained in the art of soul-magic in Ulgu’s depths. Cyreni’s guards are hand-picked from the most skilled of the Namarti warrior caste. Clad in thick armour, their wicked serrated glaives can tear the guts out of their foes. Alongside them swims Cephanyr, a creature of the deep capable of sensing soulstuff from great distances.
entries.description:
The models in this unit are:
• Cyreni of the Abyss (champion, armed with Lanmari Weapons)
• Alathyrr (armed with Lanmari Weapons)
• Renglaith (armed with Lanmari Weapons)
• Cephanyr (armed with Cephanyr’s Tentacles)

entries.name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Sea

abilityDetails.name: Dormant Energies
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Tsunami of Terror
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 3 different visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target those units until the start of your next turn.

abilityDetails.name: Vengeful Waves
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Tranquillity of the Abyss
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.flavour: An Eidolon of Mathlann is a mystical conjuration that embodies a long-forgotten god. When summoned in its aspect of the sea, this entity can call upon the magic of the ocean to bolster allies or send enemies fleeing in terror.

entries.name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Storm

abilityDetails.name: Crashing Upon The Foe
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities.

abilityDetails.name: Pulled Into The Depths
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Drench With Hate
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

melee: Spear of Repressed Fury and Crulhook

entries.flavour: In its aspect of the storm an Eidolon of Mathlann is the vengeance of the Idoneth made manifest, a living tempest that surges upwards before crashing upon the foe with tidal‑wave force.

entries.name: Elathain’s Soulraid

abilityDetails.name: Elathain’s Lurelight
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to this unit equal to the roll.

abilityDetails.name: Soulnet
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit’s Elathain Ill-fated is on the battlefield, pick an enemy INFANTRY unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

entries.flavour: Elathain was dubbed the Ill-fated for failing to harvest the essence of Ghur’s Silent People. Yet the Soulrender remains dedicated as ever, wielding the grim tools of his trade to claim a bounty of spirits. Elathain’s companions are a disparate lot, the Akhelian knight Fuirann battling alongside the Namarti Tammael and the bond-beasts Duinclaw and Spinefin. Together, however, they fight as one to claim souls for their enclave.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Soulraid Weapons. The models in this unit are:
• Elathain Ill-fated (champion)
• Tammael (also armed with a Riptide Harpoon)
• Fuirann
• Duinclaw
• Spinefin

entries.name: Ikon of the Sea

abilityDetails.name: Rapid Approach
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use a RUN ability and still use CHARGE abilities later in the turn.

abilityDetails.name: The Surging Sea
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN unit within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3.

entries.flavour: Channelling the unfathomable calm and foreboding immensity of the deepest waters, Ikons of the Sea surge into battle alongside their Idoneth kin, overwhelming the enemy with their unwavering focus and terrifying momentum. To witness such martial perfection is an inspiration to any Idoneth warrior.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Akhelian Raidmaster.

entries.name: Ikon of the Storm

abilityDetails.name: Whirlpool’s Fury
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Enemy units cannot use RETREAT abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
Friendly units that use a RETREAT ability while they are wholly within 12" of this unit can still use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities later in the turn.
No mortal damage is inicted on friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units by RETREAT abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Storm of Blades
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Ikons of the Storm aim to embody the destructive force of a raging ocean. Wielding twin blades, they hurl themselves into battle, heedless of any personal danger as they carve their enemies apart. Foes are helpless in the face of the Ikon’s whirling maelstrom of steel, and those with a mind to flee are cut down before they can take a single step.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Akhelian Raidmaster.

entries.name: Incarnate of the Deep

abilityDetails.name: Surrender to the Sea
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: When this MANIFESTATION is removed from play, each friendly Abyssal Tendril on the battlefield is automatically removed from play.

abilityDetails.name: Wild Form
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time this MANIFESTATION is targeted by the ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilityDetails.name: Grasping Tendrils
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if it is your turn. On a 4+:
• You can remove 1 friendly Abyssal Tendril from the battlefield.
• If there are fewer than 2 friendly Abyssal Tendrils on the battlefield, you can set up an Abyssal Tendril wholly within 9" of this MANIFESTATION.

entries.flavour: Conjured through elemental ritual and empowered by the spirits of the ocean, an Incarnate of the Deep is a ship-breaking tempest given physical form. Reaching out with serpent-like appendages, it seizes its prey and draws them inexorably in, drowning them within its turbulent mass.

entries.name: Isharann Soulrender

abilityDetails.name: Hangman’s Knot
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

abilityDetails.name: Lurelight
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 3 different friendly NAMARTI units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
Effect: Make a lurelight roll of D3 for each target unit. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to the target unit equal to the roll.

entries.flavour: Unlike the rest of their Isharann kin, Soulrenders fight face to face with their foes, reaping spirit-matter with every swing of their scythe-like talúnhooks. In battle, they can channel their mystical powers to revive fallen Namarti.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Isharann Emissary.

entries.name: Isharann Soulscryer

abilityDetails.name: Finder of Ways
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared the ‘%000017205Unpredictable Tide%’ ability or the ‘%000017221Steed of Tides%’ ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Instead of setting up the targets as described in the ability used, set them up on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 7" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: Soulscryers work their strange magics to navigate the utter darkness of the deep places. Their eldritch senses allow them to guide other Idoneth along hidden paths in the realms’ oceans and rivers, so that they can strike the foe from unexpected angles.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Isharann Emissary.

entries.name: Isharann Tidecaster

abilityDetails.name: Master of the Ethersea
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Make an Isharann ritual roll of D6.
Effect: On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
Creeping Mist: Friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 12" of them.
Surging Stream: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units.
Spiteful Riptide: Each time an enemy unit uses a RETREAT ability, after the effect of that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit.

entries.flavour: Isharann Tidecasters are the Idoneth’s most potent frontline wizards, capable of directing the surging currents of the ethersea in order to alter the momentum of battle or to steal the very breath from their foes.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Isharann Emissary.

entries.name: Lotann, Warden of the Soul Ledgers

abilityDetails.name: Catalogue of Souls
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, give this unit a soul-quota token.

abilityDetails.name: Fount of Willpower
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a friendly %000006435ISHARANN% unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s soul-quota tokens. Then, you can re-roll the casting roll.

abilityDetails.name: Empowered By Memory
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: The target’s melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Lotann is the Warden of the Soul Ledgers, whose task it is to oversee the reaping of spirit-essences across the enclaves. A skilled arcanist in his own right, Lotann channels the gestalt memories of the Idoneth to empower his kin.

entries.name: Mathaela, Oracle of the Abyss

abilityDetails.name: Crushing Pressure
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilityDetails.name: Siren Song of the Abyss
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ Companion weapons.

entries.flavour: Mysterious and terrifying, the Oracle of the Abyss only rises from their lightless domain when the existence of the Deepkin is threatened. Wielding the crushing magic of the deepest ocean planes, Mathaela annihilates the Idoneth’s foes and stirs the very realmseas into violent motion.

entries.name: Namarti Reavers

abilityDetails.name: Strike on the Move
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use SHOOT abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

entries.flavour: Armed with silent‑firing whisperbows, Namarti Reavers are the fast‑moving scouts and archers of the Idoneth Deepkin Phalanxes. Despite their eerie and disturbing lack of eyes, they are uncannily accurate, using senses other than sight to pinpoint their targets.

entries.name: Namarti Thralls

abilityDetails.name: Sweeping Blows
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit.
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If any damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that FIGHT ability are allocated to any enemy units, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by those enemy units for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The core infantry of the Idoneth Deepkin, Namarti Thralls advance into battle brandishing vast two-handed weapons known as lanmari. Despite their blindness and the heft of their blades, they whirl and chop with aelven grace.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Isharann Tidecaster

abilityDetails.name: Master of the Ethersea
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: If the target is NAMARTI, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, make an Isharann ritual roll of D6. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn.
Torrent of Blows: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. That weapon has Crit (2 Hits).
Protection of the Waves: While this unit is within 3" of and visible to the target, both units have WARD (5+

entries.flavour: True masters of the ethersea, Isharann Tidecasters can manipulate this eldritch ocean to protect their allies and destroy their foes. They bring the Searing Sea to the Charrwind Coast, ensuring it is they who control the ebb and flow of battle.
entries.notes:
This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Isharann Emissary.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Namarti Reavers

abilityDetails.name: Merciless Hunters
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: After that SHOOT ability has been resolved, if all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit and any models in that unit were slain, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn. If all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit and no models in that unit were slain, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.

entries.flavour: Fast‐moving scouts and archers, the eyeless Namarti Reavers are as uncannily accurate with their whisperbows upon the scorched earth of the Great Parch as they are beneath the waves.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Akhelian Thrallmaster

abilityDetails.name: Way of the Vortex
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit and friendly NAMARTI units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Raider Captain
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 3 friendly Namarti Thralls units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
Effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

entries.flavour: Many ruthless Akhelian Thrallmasters ply the coasts of the Everspring Swathe, seeking out the rich accumulations of souls that can be found there. Masters of guerrilla warfare, these swordmasters and their Namarti warriors use the environment to protect them against enemy attacks as they advance, before charging in to deliver a killing strike.
entries.notes:
This HERO can join an eligible regiment as an Akhelian Raidmaster.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Namarti Thralls

abilityDetails.name: Hit-and-Run Tactics
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit’s attacks.
Effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, if this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.

entries.flavour: Namarti Thralls have proved as skilled in waging strike-and-fade war amidst the jungles of Ghyran as they are in the kelp forests of their undersea home. Enhanced by the ethersea, their extrasensory powers allow them to isolate their prey, lashing out with their lanmari blades before retreating into the shadows under the cover of briny mists.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Volturnos, High King of the Deep

abilityDetails.name: Cealith, the High King’s Shield
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has WARD (3+) against mortal damage inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities or abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.

abilityDetails.name: First Among Akhelians
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly AKHELIAN units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Supreme Lord of Tides
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 3 other friendly IDONETH DEEPKIN units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

melee: Uasall’s Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

entries.flavour: Volturnos is the last of the Cythai, a warrior whose cunning and prowess are legendary. Riding to battle atop Uasall, Prince of Deepmares, the High King carves a path through the foe, inspiring the Idoneth to ever greater deeds.
